_note: Danger signs checked by fixed rules (not AI), so the AI can never miss or downgrade them. 'patterns' are regular expressions matched against what the patient said. Urgency: emergency > urgent_today > see_doctor_soon > self_care.

rules.name: Chest pain or pressure
rules.message: Chest pain or pressure can be a heart attack. Call an ambulance or go to the emergency department now.

rules.name: Trouble breathing
rules.message: Serious trouble breathing needs help straight away. Go to the emergency department now.

rules.name: Possible stroke signs
rules.message: Sudden weakness, a drooping face or slurred speech can be a stroke. Call an ambulance now; every minute matters.

rules.name: Serious bleeding
patterns: bleeding (a lot|heavily|badly|won'?t stop|will not stop|does not stop|doesn'?t stop)
rules.message: Heavy bleeding, or blood in vomit or black stools, needs urgent care. Go to the emergency department now.

rules.name: Fainting, fits or unconsciousness
rules.message: Fainting, a fit or not waking up properly needs emergency care now.

rules.name: Severe allergic reaction
rules.message: Swelling of the face, lips or throat can be a severe allergic reaction. Get emergency help now.

rules.name: Thoughts of self-harm
rules.message: You deserve support right now. Please talk to someone today: call your local emergency number or a crisis helpline, go to the nearest emergency department, or tell someone you trust.

rules.name: Sudden severe headache
rules.message: A sudden, very severe headache needs to be checked straight away. Go to the emergency department.

rules.name: Bleeding or pain in pregnancy
rules.message: Bleeding or severe pain during pregnancy needs urgent care. Go to the emergency department or maternity unit now.

rules.name: Stiff neck with fever
rules.message: A stiff neck, especially with fever or headache, should be checked by a doctor today.

rules.name: Fever in a baby
rules.message: A fever in a baby should be checked by a doctor today. If the baby is under 3 months old, go now.

rules.name: Severe stomach pain
rules.message: Severe stomach pain should be checked by a doctor today.

rules.name: Signs of dehydration
rules.message: Not keeping fluids down or not passing urine can mean dehydration. See a doctor today.

rules.name: Very high fever
rules.message: A very high fever should be checked by a doctor today.
